question: In which of the following years was Sundarbans National Park given the tag of UNESCO World Heritage Site?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1987**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sundarbans National Park:**

 
 
• The Sundarbans National Park is a national park, tiger reserve, and biosphere reserve in West Bengal.
 
• It is part of the Sundarbans on the Ganges Delta, and adjacent to the Sundarban Reserve Forest in Bangladesh.
 
• The delta is densely covered by mangrove forests and is one of the largest reserves for the Royal Bengal tiger.
 
• It was listed into the **UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.**
 
• It was added to the list of UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves in 1989.
 
• It has been designated as a Ramsar site since 2019.
 
• It is the home 260 bird species and is home to many rare and globally threatened wildlife species such as the Estuarine Crocodile, Royal Bengal Tiger, Water Monitor Lizard, Gangetic Dolphin and Olive Ridley Turtles.
 
• It is the only mangrove forest in the world inhabited by tigers.
